nodes.name: help-topics.ts
nodes.summary: In-app help system content database defining nine help categories (getting started, power management, enhancement slotting, incarnates, etc.) and all searchable HelpTopic entries with keywords, steps, tips, and optional demo media, plus keyword-scored search and category filtering helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Topics can attach a React ComponentType as an inline demo, coupling this data module lightly to the component layer via type-only import.

nodes.name: searchHelpTopics
nodes.summary: Searches HELP_TOPICS by scoring query matches against topic titles, descriptions, and keyword lists, returning ranked results.

nodes.name: getTopicsByCategory
nodes.summary: Filters the help topic list down to the entries belonging to a given help category.

nodes.name: power-lookup.ts
nodes.summary: Facade re-exporting the active dataset's power lookup implementation (datasets/homecoming/power-lookup), which composes the powerset, pool, epic-pool, and inherent accessors so lookups resolve against the currently active dataset.

nodes.name: stat-colors.ts
nodes.summary: Facade preserving the historical import path by re-exporting the server-agnostic stat-colors palette from src/data/core.

nodes.name: empty.js
nodes.summary: Intentionally empty module exporting an empty object, used to stub out server-only imports when bundling for the browser.

nodes.name: useIsTouchDevice.ts
nodes.summary: Touch-capability detection: an isTouchDevice predicate plus a useIsTouchDevice React hook that exposes whether the current device supports touch input.

nodes.name: isTouchDevice
nodes.summary: Predicate checking browser APIs to determine whether the current device supports touch input.

nodes.name: useIsTouchDevice
nodes.summary: React hook wrapping the touch-device predicate in component state so touch-aware UI can render conditionally.

nodes.name: useLongPress.ts
nodes.summary: React hook implementing long-press gesture detection with configurable hold duration and movement threshold, distinguishing long-press from tap callbacks for touch interactions.

nodes.name: useLongPress
nodes.summary: Hook returning pointer event handlers that fire onLongPress after a configurable hold duration (cancelling on movement past a threshold) or onTap for shorter presses.

nodes.name: useSwipeToRemove.ts
nodes.summary: React hook detecting horizontal swipe gestures (with a max-vertical-drift guard) to trigger a removal callback, used for swipe-to-remove interactions on touch devices.

nodes.name: useSwipeToRemove
nodes.summary: Hook returning touch handlers that invoke onSwipe when a horizontal swipe exceeds the distance threshold while staying within the vertical drift limit; can be disabled via the enabled flag.
